{{Quote|These fighters are the latest design and a symbol of the Sith Empire.|Darth Rauder|<ref name="legacy45" />}}
These '''Sith-Imperial starfighters''' were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] designed by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Sith_forces_over_Agamar.jpg|thumb]]
The Sith-Imperial starfighters served as a successor to the [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighters]] used by Imperial forces. Like the previous fighter, the Sith-Imperial starfighters appeared to share common elements with the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighters used by the Empire for over a century, and externally resembled the [[Nssis-class Clawcraft|''Nssis''-class Clawcraft]] that were used by the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] decades before.

==History==
Intended to be first deployed during [[Operation: Thunderstroke]], these starfighters replaced [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron's]] TIE Predators under orders of [[Darth Rauder]], a [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] and the leader of the pilots of the [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce]]. Darth Rauder ordered the members of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gunn Yage]]'s squadron that she and her subordinates would fly the new fighters during their mission to capture [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]].

A short time later, these fighters were once again employed in the [[Devastation of Da Soocha]] and were also employed at the [[Attack on the Hidden Temple]].
